setup_graph_parallel_groups: setup graph parallel and data parallel process groups for distributed training with a given group size and backend
setup_gp: setup graph parallel training from a config dict specifying gp_gpus and distributed_backend for distributed model training
reduce_from_model_parallel_region: reduce a tensor across the graph parallel group using all_reduce for model parallel aggregation
scatter_to_model_parallel_region: scatter a tensor across the graph parallel group by splitting along the first dimension for model parallel distribution
scale_backward_grad: scale backward gradients by the graph parallel world size to correct DDP mean reduction in graph parallel training
